key_insight: ERank turns a frozen deep encoder into a simple, label-free measure of how visually rich an image is. It estimates how many independent feature directions an image activates, so plain images score lower and complex, detailed images score higher.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the lack of an efficient, per-image, annotation-free way to quantify image complexity or richness. Existing measures can be hand-crafted, task-specific, or expensive, while ERank can be computed from a single forward pass.
method: Extract a deep feature map from a pretrained frozen encoder for each image.
Compute the channel covariance of the feature map and derive its effective rank (ERank) as the richness score.
Analyze ERank’s behavior under noise and validate it against human-intuitive and signal-based proxies such as bitrate, sharpness, and edge density.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, ERank provides a fast, practical way to rank images by complexity without labels or retraining. This can help with dataset analysis, sample selection, quality assessment, and understanding how visual content relates to model features.

paper_title: ERank in Latent Space as an Image-Complexity and Richness Measure
